question: Should disclosure labels wear the tap colour, or stay the one grey? One rule (.exp-more summary) draws 13 of them: Preview and More Options on Export, the three reminder sheets ("Area, Linked Action and Follow-up", "More Actions", "Why This Appeared"), Gym's and Library's "About…" sections, Classify, and "The Sets" on every All Data and Insights row. Today they are grey with a chevron mark in front. The Colour Key gives a tappable control that is not button-shaped the tap red. But §AL says every tappable control that is not the primary is a capsule, and the Export sheet is catalogued with one red (Export File). If they take the tap colour, sheets must use --tint-on-sheet (white in dark, dark red in light), pages use --tint, and components.css .rem-more > summary { color: var(--tx-2) } has to follow. The size half of this finding is already applied.

The user's own chat bubble is a brand-red fill: .bubble-user in onboarding and .chat-user in Chat. Should it stay that way under the Colour Key? Two rulings disagree here. On 2026-08-14 you approved the red user bubble (components.css:2581, 'chat-user rides the accent'), and laws.test.ts:971 explicitly exempts both .chat-user and .bubble-user as 'identity marks, not actions'. The 2026-09-22 key (R3) says --accent* on anything that cannot be tapped is a violation. If you keep the bubble red, it stays as a sanctioned exception and nothing changes. If you want it neutral, both bubbles have to move together to the same fill, for example var(--sel-bg) / var(--sel-fg). That means editing components.css .chat-user as well as uniformity.css .bubble-user. Moving only the onboarding bubble would make it disagree with the Chat screen, so I left both alone.

On 2026-09-16 you asked for colour on the Classify sheet ("it's ugly, has no color"). Its selected chips are now coloured by question: lime for muscles, violet for equipment, cyan for how the lift is described. The library row chips use the same hues. Under the Colour Key (2026-09-22), colour is for meaning only, and on Health these inks already mean done, budget/pair and now. Should the selected chips go back to the app's neutral selected pill, library row chips included? Or keep the question colours as a named exemption to §AM?

The Account screen's 72px avatar (your initial) sits on a brand-red disc and cannot be tapped. The Colour Key says brand red means 'tap this', but laws.test.ts:971 exempts .av-accent as an identity mark, and the same class is a real button on Today and a red-coloured person's avatar in People. Should your own avatar on Account go neutral (grey disc, white initial), or stay brand red as your identity mark? If neutral, the change goes in AccountPage.tsx (not a stylesheet-only fix).
answer: Keep the red disc; make it tappable to change the picture (photo or icon)

question: The Remember star turns filled YELLOW when on (.row-star.on { color: var(--yellow) }). Your 2026-09-12 ruling (catalog line 572) says 'filled yellow', but the Colour Key (§AM) says there are eight colours and no ninth, and yellow means nothing in it. Keep the yellow star, or make the on-star white (the fill already shows on vs off)? The Email VIP star (.mstar) is the same question: a remembered VIP thread shows both stars on one row, so whichever you pick applies to both.

Today's red "Now" head is sanctioned in the rulebook and stays. Brain's two red heads, "Shaping JARVIS Now" and "Needs You" (BrainTop.tsx:172 and :204), were kept loud by your C-38 pick on 2026-09-12, and LAW 11 records that pick as an exemption. But the Colour Key (2026-09-22) says brand red on anything that cannot be tapped is wrong. Should those two Brain heads go quiet like every other head (grey label, quiet hairline), leaving Today's Now as the only red head? If yes: BrainTop.tsx adds sh2-quiet to both heads, and the BrainTop line in LAW 11 (laws.test.ts ~3565) is removed. No components.css change is needed, because the default .sh2 .t accent is what Today's sanctioned Now head uses.
answer: Make them grey like the rest

question: The conditioning clock face is a full-screen black readout the stylesheet says is 'read across a room'. Should its 'ROUND 2 OF 10' line (.cf-round, 15px caps) stay at 15px as a stated arm's-length exception to the two-size subtext rule, or drop to the 11px kicker size like every other caps label? The 11px size is correct by the rule but would be small mid-workout. The same question covers the face's 13px caps format tag (.cf-fmt) and the landscape corner labels (.cf-corner). Everything else in #627 (blue off the format tag and the corner, name and 'last' split at 14px in --tx-3) was already applied by an earlier batch.

Schedule's Now rule paints NOW, the LIVE state word and its hairline in the system red. That is your C-28 pick of 2026-09-12: 'LIVE is the only red, on the Now rule alone'. The Colour Key of 2026-09-22 gives that red only to late, overdue and missed, and has no entry for 'now'; Health uses cyan for now. Should the red Now rule stay, written into §AM as a named exception? Or should NOW and LIVE go white with a neutral hairline? Two constraints: laws.test.ts 'the Now rule is a hairline and a word, never a fill' pins the hairline to --sys-red, and in light the NOW word uses --on-light-red, the brand words-red.

Life > Areas: the Health card sits on a green --good-tint panel with a green border, green-filled section chips and green chip glyphs, all to say 'this is Health'. Under §AM (2026-09-22) green means done / on track, and an area's colour belongs on its dot only. You approved this card on 2026-09-16: the component quotes 'we can keep the green background' and 'keep the font white in the health section'. A ruled.css comment from the same day quotes 'remove the green background' about the older row. Should §AM override that approval? If yes, the card goes plain like the other area cards and the chips go grey, with the area colour only on the tile. If no, it becomes a named §AM exemption.
answer: Make it plain like the others

question: The overflow lines under a list ("13 More Waiting", "4 More in Anytime") can be tapped, and the Colour Key gives a tappable word brand red. On 2026-09-11 you moved exactly these from a red link to a quiet grey line, and a law was written to keep them quiet. Keep them quiet grey (the chevron marks the tap, the way a whole row is tappable without being red), or make them tap red like See All? Either way they now read in normal text at the fact size (14px), not tiny capitals.

In light mode, an estimate (sky, e.g. 'About 3h', 'Saves 5 min', 'Est 45 Min') is Apple's own light cyan, #32ADE6. On white it reads about 2.5:1, and on an amber banner under 2:1. On 2026-09-12 you chose Apple's light green and amber as shipped over darker, easier-to-read versions. Same call here: keep Apple's cyan, or use a darker sky (#006592, 6.4:1) for estimates in light mode only?
answer: Use a darker blue in light mode

question: Applied from the Colour Key; say if you want any of it back. Today's stat tiles: the Late tile is red from the first late task (it was amber for one or two); the Due tile is amber (it was grey); Brain's area Done tile is green (it was grey). Events stay grey.
The white footer text on pale goal/project cards measures 2.8 to 4.5:1. Add a dark fade under the footer?
answer: Add a dark fade under the footer

question: Quiet (today/quiet.tsx) colours every day count red, for example "3 days left" and "Due in 5 days". You set that on 2026-09-21: "They should both be red and all instances. We need everything uniform without drifting". It was about this exact pair: "Mailchimp trial ends, 3 days left" next to "Invoice · 84 Days". The Colour Key from 2026-09-22 makes a countdown to a due date amber (needs you soon) and keeps red for late. Should a day count that runs forward ("N days left", "in N days") now be amber, with red kept for ages like "Slid 3d" and "84 Days"? Or does your 09-21 ruling stand? If amber, it also needs a .qd-soon { color: var(--warn); } rule in components.css, which is not my file.

This is dave-queue.json #317, which the rulebook lists as held for Dave ('the Classify sheet's question colours', library row chips included), so nothing was changed. The Exercises page chips are coloured by axis: muscles lime, equipment violet, movement plain. That followed your 2026-09-16 'too much of the same color'. Under the 2026-09-22 Colour Key, Health lime means done and violet means budget/pair. Should the chips go neutral (fill only, with secondary muscles as an outline), or keep the axis hues as a named exemption? If neutral: chipTone in LibraryPage.tsx becomes `ch.tone === "secondary" ? " sec" : ""`. ruled.css would also need `.ruled .ex-chip.sec` to show secondary as an outline, because `--tx-2` and `--tx-3` are the same hex and would make primary and secondary look identical.

This belongs with question 317 (the Classify sheet's question colours, held for you). On the Muscles card's facts line, 'Secondary Biceps' is drawn in Health cyan, while the chips above it use lime for muscles. Under the Colour Key, cyan means 'now' on Health. HEALTH law 2 also says a hue should land on the datum, and here it lands on the label word 'Secondary' too. Two options. (A) Keep the cyan as part of the Classify sheet's named question-colour exemption. (B) Make both facts quiet: for example, 'Primary Hamstrings' as the line's one grey and the secondary as a white <b>, with no hue. The placeholder half of this finding ('No primary yet') is already applied.

The warning under a destructive action is amber, bold (.slip-warn). That covers Advanced's 'This device only · No undo' under Clear Local Data, Account's 'Permanent · Every note, task and event is erased' under an armed Delete Account, and Account's delete-error line. In the Colour Key, amber means 'needs you soon' (due, next, stalled, near a limit), and a permanence warning is none of those. By the key it would drop to the note's own grey, italic like the rest of the note. Keep these warnings amber as a named exception, or let them go grey? The middle dots stay either way (field-note rule). Covers #437 and #438.

Event sheet, Travel row: when a place has a remembered travel time, a grey line under 'Travel' says '25 min last time', beside the grey 'None' value. That is two greys on one row. The only fix that satisfies the key is to make the line a one-tap red link (.note-fix) that sets Travel to 25 min, and that adds new behaviour. Today it only informs, and 25 min is not in the Travel menu, so using it means Custom and typing 25. Should 'Use 25 min last time' become a tap that fills Travel? Recommended: yes.
